pressureField: A KFX mutation must issue one Warrant into the current named Fact Cut before materialization, prove that exact Warrant/Cut/revision is still current, and settle Work, Warrant, Episode and outcome into one successor Cut without letting package identity or runtime capability synthesize authority.
candidateInvariants: purpose, operation, package and authority roots determine the planned Warrant
the Warrant Fact is issued into a named Cut before materialization
mutation presents the exact planned Warrant root, Cut root and revision
settlement consumes the Warrant and records Work, Episode and Settlement in one successor Cut
history is reconstructed from immutable Fact versions rather than a private lifecycle journal
capability admission and product identity do not become Warrant authority
failureOrCounterexample: KFX uses named-Cut revision fencing rather than a generic renewable lease object and does not independently prove generic delegation, residual-responsibility transfer, renewal, or holder takeover semantics.

observation.summary: KFX issues a purpose-bound Warrant Fact before mutation, checks exact Warrant/Cut/revision authority before side effects, and consumes it through Work/Episode/Settlement Facts and expected-old Cut CAS.

genericClaims.basis: The plan binds purpose, operation, package, policy, admission, capability and approval roots into the Warrant root.
A Warrant Fact and issuance receipt advance the named Cut before package materialization begins.
Apply requires the exact planned Warrant root and current authority Cut/revision; stale plans and concurrent writers fail closed.
The successor Cut records settled Work, consumed Warrant, realized Episode and Settlement with a rooted receipt.
History reconstructs immutable Warrant and settlement Fact versions without a second KFX lifecycle journal.
KFX uses Cut/revision CAS and exact Warrant roots, not a portable renewable lease generation, heartbeat or takeover contract.
The retained runtime facts do not express a generic delegation chain or residual-responsibility transfer.

profileSpecificClaims.basis: KFX owns one named Cut whose exact expected-old revision serializes lifecycle mutation.
Capability grants, product assembly and supply-chain admission remain separate inputs and cannot synthesize the Warrant.

promotion.reason: KFX demonstrates one product-specific Warrant lifecycle and cannot self-promote the KFD draft or impose its Fact kernel on adopters.
